name: Rodie Garrett
original_name: ローディー・ギャレット
source:
A gang boss of bandits that infest the border. Rodie is cold-blooded, brutal and cunning. She is a woman who lives in the aesthetics of evil.

[Translated from [url=http://web.archive.org/web/20020208134318/http://www.web-giga.com/win31/kingdam.htm]the official site[/url].]
